_comment: Route weights derived from DGCA domestic city-pair passenger traffic data.
source: Vonter/india-aviation-traffic (https://github.com/Vonter/india-aviation-traffic), licensed ODbL-1.0. Data sourced from DGCA.
methodology: Passenger shares computed over the Trailing 12-Month (T12M) window 2025-06 to 2026-05 from aggregated/domestic/city.csv via scripts/derive_weights.py. PaxToCity2 + PaxFromCity2 summed across all 12 months for each city pair, restricted to the 12-route APIx basket, and normalised to sum to 1.0. City names mapped to IATA codes with Metropolitan Catchment Aggregation: DELHI=DEL, MUMBAI/MUMBAI(MUMBAI)/MUMBAI(NAVI MUMBAI)=BOM, BENGALURU=BLR, KOLKATA=CCU, CHENNAI=MAA, HYDERABAD=HYD, GOA/GOA(DABOLIM,SOUTH GOA)/GOA(MOPA,NORTH GOA)/MOPA,GOA/DABOLIM=GOI. See docs/data-sources/dgca-route-weights.md.
_coverage_note: all_domestic_pax and basket_share_of_domestic_pct are null because this file predates their addition. Re-run scripts/derive_weights.py --download to populate them; the script now also auto-detects the latest trailing 12-month window rather than defaulting to a hardcoded one.
